title: Dolan's early appearances and Stanton Friedman pressing him on Bob Lazar

tellings.quote: Um so, I mean, I'm there and Stan like I'm sitting alone with him and he's checking me out. He's like, "Who is this guy?" Because I just written a a book, big fat book, and uh he's like, "So, what's your opinion on Bob Lazar?"

plain: The writer Richard Dolan says that in 2001, at his early public appearances in Laughlin, Nevada, and St. Louis, he found himself alone with Stanton Friedman, an established figure in UFO research, who was sizing him up. Dolan tells Michels that he had just written "a big fat book" and that Friedman's test question was, "So, what's your opinion on Bob Lazar?", meaning a man whose claims divide the UFO world. Dolan tells it to show how a newcomer had to prove himself to the old guard.
